## Overview

This pilot evaluates whether the expanded summary metrics isolate extinction drivers across a replicated grid of archetypes, threat scenarios, and observation settings.

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("exdyn.sandbox", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
    pkgload::load_all(export_all = FALSE, helpers = FALSE, attach_testthat = FALSE)
  } else {
    stop("exdyn.sandbox package is not available and pkgload is missing.")
  }
} else {
  library(exdyn.sandbox)
}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
store_path <- if (dir.exists("../_targets")) "../_targets" else "_targets"
tar_load(c(
  exp_grid, results,
  confusion_primary, confusion_secondary,
  feature_importance_primary, primary_model,
  classifiers, diagnostic_maps, save_diagnostics,
  design_guidance
), store = store_path)
secondary_model <- if (primary_model == "ranger") "glmnet" else "ranger"
primary_macro <- if (primary_model == "ranger") classifiers$ranger$macro_f1 else classifiers$glmnet$macro_f1
secondary_macro <- if (secondary_model == "ranger") classifiers$ranger$macro_f1 else classifiers$glmnet$macro_f1
```

```{r}
defaults <- list(
  nx = exp_grid$nx[[1]],
  ny = exp_grid$ny[[1]],
  years = exp_grid$years[[1]],
  presence = exp_grid$presence_rate[[1]],
  fossil_sites = exp_grid$fossil_sites[[1]],
  replicates = exp_grid$replicate[[nrow(exp_grid)]]
)
knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(Parameter = names(defaults), Value = unlist(defaults, use.names = FALSE)))
```

Primary model: **`r primary_model`** (macro F1 = **`r sprintf("%.3f", primary_macro)`**). Secondary model: **`r secondary_model`** (macro F1 = **`r sprintf("%.3f", secondary_macro)`**).

## Front Diagnostics

```{r}
tp_file <- grep("TP_predation_front", save_diagnostics, value = TRUE)
tx_file <- grep("TX_predation_front", save_diagnostics, value = TRUE)
d_file  <- grep("D_predation_front", save_diagnostics, value = TRUE)
files <- tibble::tibble(
  label = c("Predation arrival (T_P)", "Extirpation time (T_X)", "Distance to nearest seed (D)"),
  path = c(tp_file[1], tx_file[1], d_file[1])
)
purrr::walk2(files$path, files$label, ~{
  if (!is.na(.x) && file.exists(.x)) {
    cat("### ", .y, "\n\n", sep = "")
    knitr::include_graphics(.x)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
})
```

## Total Abundance Exemplars

```{r}
get_series <- function(row) {
  pars <- row$params[[1]]
  arche <- exdyn_archetype(row$species[[1]])
  arche$beta_H <- pars$habitat_beta
  fields <- exdyn_make_fields_param(
    nx = row$nx[[1]], ny = row$ny[[1]], years = row$years[[1]],
    pars = pars, scenario = row$scenario[[1]], seeds = row$pred_seeds[[1]]
  )
  N <- exdyn_simulate(
    nx = row$nx[[1]], ny = row$ny[[1]], years = row$years[[1]], fields = fields,
    pars = arche, K0 = row$cell_k[[1]], alpha = row$alpha[[1]],
    disp_mean_cells = pars$dispersal_mean_km / row$cellsize_km[[1]],
    pred = list(type = row$predation_type[[1]], c = pars$pred_c, h = pars$pred_h)
  )
  tibble::tibble(
    year = seq_len(dim(N)[3]),
    total = apply(N, 3, sum),
    scenario = row$scenario[[1]]
  )
}
examples <- exp_grid %>% group_by(scenario) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup()
series_tbl <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(examples)), function(i) get_series(examples[i, ]))

ggplot(series_tbl, aes(x = year, y = total, colour = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Total abundance", colour = "Scenario") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Front-Signature Metrics

```{r}
front_metrics <- c("r2_arrival", "r2_dist", "grad_mag", "pc_ratio", "lag_arrival_mean")
metrics_long <- results %>%
  select(scenario, all_of(front_metrics)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-scenario, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

ggplot(metrics_long, aes(x = scenario, y = value, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75, colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
centroid_metrics <- results %>%
  select(scenario, centroid_disp_per_year, r2_centroid_line) %>%
  pivot_longer(-scenario, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

ggplot(centroid_metrics, aes(x = scenario, y = value, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75, colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Scenario Recoverability

```{r}
plot_confusion <- function(conf, title) {
  ggplot(conf$confusion, aes(x = estimate, y = truth, fill = n)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), colour = "black", fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f0f9e8", high = "#0868ac") +
    labs(x = "Predicted", y = "True", fill = "Count", title = title) +
    theme_minimal()
}
plot_confusion(confusion_primary, paste0("Primary (", primary_model, ")"))
plot_confusion(confusion_secondary, paste0("Secondary (", secondary_model, ")"))
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(confusion_primary$per_class, caption = "Primary model: per-class precision/recall")
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(confusion_secondary$per_class, caption = "Secondary model: per-class precision/recall")
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(confusion_primary$overall, caption = "Primary model accuracy")
```
